items.title: Disney’s New CEO Josh D’Amaro Is Reportedly Planning Thousands of Job Cuts Ahead of Nov. 17 Earnings. Here’s What It Means for a 72-Year-Old Widow With $150,000 of Disney
items.summary: Disney reports Tuesday, Nov. 17, the first full-year report under CEO Josh D'Amaro, with thousands of job cuts reported and nothing confirmed. For a 72-year-old widow with $150,000 of Disney: a $9,414 swing, a $1,884 dividend the board could raise, and a tax decision that turns on which half of her shares got a step-up when her husband died.
